reviews.text:
(Heads up-long review)
We replaced all the glass in the front of our home.  We started out in the right direction, he came out to our home quickly and on time.  He felt he was giving us a good price so he wanted "cash only".  At that point, I should have moved on and listened to my gut but I didn't.  He kept in contact for the installation date, then it seemed to go downhill after that.  He made me feel like he was out for a quick buck, not a business owner with pride in workmanship.  He was always on the phone when I tried to speak with him, and was rushed.

We had our glass replaced in June of 2022, he told me at that time, there was an area that had given him some trouble if we had any issues to let him know.  I reached back out to him a couple of weeks later to follow up, letting him know - yes, we have broken glass and it would need replacing.  We spoke a couple of times and scheduled a day for him to come out.  He never showed up or called.  I reached out to him, he said he was having car trouble and I waited.  After that he never responded to my calls or texts again.

There is absolutely no reason a business owner should ghost a customer that did nothing to deserve that type of action.  I did not become angry,  obnoxious, or rude.  I was direct, as I had issues with broken glass left in our flower bed, their trash left in the front yard.  A sloppy caulking job but I never disrespected him in anyway.  We still have a broken glass that needs to be replaced, this is Mid August 2022 and I still have not heard back from him.
.
reviews.author: Loni Parker

reviews.text:
I had a broken glass emergency. One of the balances broke in a window. The spring had exploded sending the stick up the side of the window and cracked the glass. It got jammed and  I couldn't even close the window anymore.

I called Carters after seeing good reviews online. He was ready to come out the next day to take measurements and give an estimate, if it didn't rain. When it rained, he was out the next day. When he gave an estimate, he immediately removed the broken balance so the window could close. He came out a few days later and fixed that window and replaced a few others as well.

Mr Carter knows how to repair or replace windows. He can build the frames himself. He will give you a good price. After telling him about the heat in the room, he upgraded the window to a tinted glass to cool down the room. He also recommended solar shades. With a variety of payment methods, he recommend the best payment method to avoid extra fees from using credit cards. He even recommended a good BBQ spot and fun places to take the kids.
